subtitle: Lesson 42 · MySQL Security & User Management

eyebrow: Encryption at rest: InnoDB tablespace encryption
caption: Protects stolen disks and backups, not authenticated reads — MySQL decrypts transparently for any privileged query.
require_secure_transport rejects any connection attempt made in plaintext.

code:
ALTER USER 'app_svc'@'10.0.4.%' REQUIRE SSL;
ALTER USER 'reporting'@'%' REQUIRE X509;
caption: REQUIRE X509 adds mutual authentication — the client must present a trusted certificate.
